envelope.description: Document shell, footer, breadcrumb and focus rules

body.title: Document shell, footer, breadcrumb and focus rules
body.summary: renderBoardDocument emits div.page > header.appbar (nav#crumbs.crumbs, div.appbar-tools with #status, Read-only, #refresh), #banner, main#main.body, footer.foot (p#announce, the small segmented density control #density-compact/#density-comfortable). The script renders the breadcrumb (span.wordmark left out when narrow, crumb buttons, span.sep, span.here). Focus: a new list screen focuses its chosen view button; a new epic/story/issue screen focuses its h1; a restored screen whose opener is gone falls back to the screen's first focus target; title updates no longer key on h1.screen-title.
acceptanceChecks: Exactly one aria-live region (#announce, in the footer) and one nonce'd script; the CSP is unchanged.
The breadcrumb renders the wordmark, crumbs, separators and the current place, and leaves the wordmark out when narrow.
A restored screen with no opener focuses the fallback target and does not throw; density switching still works from the footer.

tests.name: board-host.test.ts: the live region and density control sit in a small footer, and a new list screen focuses its chosen view
board-host.test.ts: the breadcrumb renders the wordmark, crumbs and current place, without the wordmark when narrow
